summary: Flat rectangular steel plate with a single row of seven 4 mm through holes at 8 mm pitch, centered on the plate's long axis.

mountingSurfaces.description: Top flat face (2.5 mm thick plate, centered), containing the 7-hole row
Bottom flat face, opposite the top, also open to the through holes

notes: Dimensions come from the printed drawing: 56 mm length, 14 mm width, 2.5 mm thickness, seven Ø4 mm holes at 8 mm pitch, and 48 mm between the first and last hole centers. The bounding box is centered at the origin with length along X, width along Y and thickness along Z. The holes sit on the Y centerline, which is the drawing's visual midline and not a printed dimension. The 4 mm end margin is derived as (56-48)/2. The holes are treated as through because the render shows light passing through some of them. A volume check of about 1740 mm³ of steel gives roughly 13.7 g, which matches the stated 14 g each. The goRAIL profile image was not used for sizing, and no other features are assumed.
